name: Tsukitate Minori
source: One of Erdõs dormitary occupant, and also one of Renri's best friend. Despite her carefree attitude, she's one of top student in school. And because of that, she's living in a "double life" at school and dorm. Even Renri is very surprised with her change of attitude, which very contrast compared when she's at the dorm.
